status: POST-HOC EXPLORATORY SENSOR DESCRIPTION. Previous median-speed outcomes and zero-median audit are known. This is not preregistration, confirmation, or a calibrated behavioral hurdle model.
question: On the unchanged matched individuals and dates, is seasonal change in reported speed associated with the fraction of positive readings or the size of positive readings?

definitions.p: Mean across original matched dates of fraction of readings with reported speed >0. A reporting event, NOT validated animal activity or movement initiation.
definitions.M: Mean across original matched dates of mean u, retaining all zero readings.
definitions.C: M/p when p>0: positive-u conditional mean in the date-equal mixture. Undefined when p=0; no pseudocount or fill.
definitions.double_difference: (falling NIGHT - falling DAY) - (rising NIGHT - rising DAY)
definitions.two_terms: For each solar zone, delta M = mean(C_F,C_R)*delta p + mean(p_F,p_R)*delta C, only when both C exist. Difference of NIGHT and DAY contributions yields total double difference. Otherwise decomposition undefined.
definitions.weights: Equal dates within individual-cell-cycle, equal eligible groups within an individual, then equal individuals within species. Never pool individual effects by their count of fixes.
definitions.uncertainty: Descriptive mean, median, individual sign counts and leave-one-individual-out mean range; no p-values, population CI or claim of statistical significance. Only n>=5 gets a species-level headline. All seven taxa retained.

limits: The publisher documents GPS-estimated ground speed and variable tag/battery schedules but provides no low-speed behavior calibration, no validated stop/move threshold and no scheduled-missing-fix denominators in this CSV.
Positive speed is not a count of movement bouts or proportion of time active. Conditional magnitude is not speed of a validated behavioral class.
Source zeros may reflect resting, rounding or sensor characteristics; the underlying cause is unidentified.
The two known repeated timestamps in selected teal blocks remain in the exact-replay primary sample and are separately counted. Original matched bird/date inclusion is not silently changed.
A mean is a NEW response, not a correction or replacement of the frozen median result. Direction changes across these responses are not contradictory tests of one estimand.
No new sensor, region, species replication or causal seasonal mechanism is added. This bounded diagnostic cannot rescue a generality claim.
stop_rule: Report all two-part descriptors once. Do not scan positive-speed cutoffs or refit matching after results. The main ecological paper remains centered on original solar-season vegetation and camera-time/place results; the GPS diagnostic is supplementary.
